description:
Who we are 

 Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America’s drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment.

 As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We’re hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years.

 What you will be doing 

 We are seeking an experienced IT Infrastructure Engineer to design and maintain the cloud and on-premise infrastructure supporting advanced defense technology systems. This role owns IT operations — automation, virtualization, data platform, and disaster recovery — and partners closely with our Security function on SIEM, NIST 800-171 compliance, and incident response. The ideal candidate has expertise in Microsoft 365 / Azure / AWS architecture, deep PowerShell automation chops, and is excited about building infrastructure at a fast-moving defense tech company.

  Responsibilities 

 
 Design and implement secure cloud infrastructure using Microsoft 365, Azure, and AWS to support defense technology platforms and mission-critical operations

 Partner with the Security Lead on SIEM operations, NIST 800-171 compliance evidence, and security tooling integration — implementing the IT-side controls and log/data pipelines that Security relies on

 Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting solutions to ensure system health, visibility, and rapid response to outages and performance issues

 Manage system patching and updates using endpoint and infrastructure management tools, ensuring systems remain secure and up to date

 Proactively monitor infrastructure and services, responding to alerts and performance degradation to maintain high availability and reliability

 Provide advanced L3/L4 technical support for bare metal servers, Linux environments, and mission-critical infrastructure

 Administer and support SQL Server environments, including performance tuning, maintenance plans, and access management

 Develop and maintain automated backup solutions, including incremental snapshots and retention policies across cloud and on-premise systems

 Architect and support disaster recovery (DR) and business continuity strategies, including failover planning, backup validation, and recovery testing

 Administer and support virtualization platforms (Hyper-V, VMware), including clustering, replication, and high availability configurations

 Plan and execute virtualization migrations and infrastructure upgrades with minimal downtime

 Identify and prioritize automation opportunities based on operational pain points and system inefficiencies

 
  You should have the following 

 
 Experience at a defense technology startup or fast-paced, high-growth technology company

 Hands-on SIEM implementation or tuning experience (Splunk, Sentinel, etc.) — a strong plus given the partnership model with Security

 Direct experience preparing for or operating under NIST 800-171, CMMC, or similar defense compliance frameworks

 Knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker containerization, and infrastructure as code tools like Terraform

 Familiarity with segmented network architectures and hybrid on-premise/cloud environments

 
 US Salary Range 

 $112,500-$157,500 USD

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are considered part of Neros' total compensation package.

 We’re an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
